exposure: Initial findings of PE (proteinuria, damage to other maternal organs, uteroplacental dysfunction)
Initial findings of PE at first diagnosis
Classification 2 (C-2): damage to other maternal organs
outcome: Premature birth at < 37 weeks of gestation
cohort: 104 women diagnosed with preeclampsia who delivered at a single hospital between 2015 and 2019
finding: Preeclampsia patients with uteroplacental dysfunction as the initial finding at diagnosis had the most unfavorable prognoses for premature birth, fetal growth restriction, acidosis, and composite adverse pregnancy outcomes.
